about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Nearly two decades of trust — from a small warehouse in Nong Khaem to world-class automotive supply chains
about.story1: Veerapong Packaging Ltd., Part. was founded on 6 November 2007 in Nong Khaem, Bangkok, with a single purpose: making sure every customer's part completes its journey intact.
about.story2: From a small protective-materials wholesaler, we grew by understanding how factories actually work — earning the trust to supply automotive parts packaging within Toyota and Hitachi supply chains, the most demanding standards in the industry.
about.story3: Today we are a full-line packaging partner to industrial plants nationwide, still guided by the same principles as day one: honesty with customers, integrity in quality, and delivery that is always on time.
about.milestone1: Veerapong Packaging founded in Nong Khaem, Bangkok, wholesaling protective materials to local factories.
about.milestone2: Expanded into automotive, supplying parts packaging into Toyota and Hitachi supplier networks.
about.milestone3: Launched full custom packaging engineering and returnable packaging programs.
about.milestone4: Entering our 19th year with digital services — consultations and quotes online, around the clock.
about.mission: Deliver packaging that truly protects, at competitive cost, with service factories can rely on every day.
about.vision: To be the first name factories across ASEAN think of for industrial packaging.
about.value1Desc: We never downgrade material specs for margin — one damaged part costs more than a whole lot of packaging.
about.value2Desc: Production lines can't stop, so we deliver on schedule, every time.
about.value3Desc: We help customers cut long-term packaging costs, because their success is ours.
about.businessValue: Manufacturer & distributor of corrugated plastic boxes (PP Board) and protective packaging — EPE foam, EVA, air bubble — plus printing for all media types

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Ask our AI assistant or message us on LINE
faq.a1: It's flexible by product type. Standard items like bubble wrap, film and tape start at small quantities; custom jobs depend on spec. Tell us your monthly usage and we'll propose the most cost-effective plan.
faq.q2: Can I get a sample before ordering?
faq.a2: Yes — every custom job includes a prototype for real-world testing, typically within 5–10 business days of receiving your part or drawings.
faq.q3: How is delivery handled and how long does it take?
faq.a3: We deliver direct to factories nationwide. Bangkok metro is typically 1–3 business days, and we can set recurring deliveries matched to your production plan.
faq.a4: Yes — it's our core expertise: returnable boxes, dividers and part trays built to the standards used in Toyota and Hitachi supply chains.
faq.q5: What information do you need for a quote?
faq.a5: Part dimensions and weight, monthly volume, and any special requirements (ESD-safe, export, etc.). We reply with a proposal within 24 business hours.
faq.q6: Is Future Board the same as PP Board?
faq.a6: Yes — Future Board is the common Thai name for PP corrugated plastic sheet (PP Board / corrugated plastic). We manufacture it ourselves: standard sheets 1300×2450 mm, 2–10 mm thick, 14 colours, cut and formed into boxes to fit your part.

quote.title: How our packaging is priced
quote.subtitle: Every job is made to its own size and spec, so there is no single list price. This page explains what moves the number and what to send us for the fastest quote.
quote.factorsTitle: Six things that set the price
quote.f1d: PP Board runs 2-10 mm thick — thicker is stronger and costs more. Foam is priced by thickness and density the same way.
quote.f2d: Larger runs spread tooling and setup across more pieces, so the unit price falls as volume rises.
quote.f3d: PP Board comes in 14 colours. Printing a logo or text adds a production step and shows up in the price.
quote.f4d: Plain sheets are cheapest. Die-cutting, folding, fitted partitions or full box assembly each add labour.
quote.f5d: EPE, EVA and PU differ in cost, and anti-static grades for electronics work carry a premium over standard grades.
quote.f6d: Planned orders price better than rush jobs, because we can schedule production and buy material to suit.
quote.prepareTitle: Send us this and we can quote
quote.prepareNote: You don't need all of it — a photo of the part is enough to start the conversation.
quote.p1: Dimensions of the part you need to protect (W x L x H)
quote.p2: Quantity per order, and roughly per month
quote.p3: How it will be used — export, in-plant returnable, or single trip
quote.p4: Photos of the part, or a drawing / CAD file if you have one
quote.p5: The date you need it by
quote.s1: Send the details by phone, LINE or email
quote.s2: We quote, with a material recommendation
quote.s3: We make a sample to test against your real part
quote.s4: You approve, we produce and deliver to your plant
quote.ctaText: Our team replies with pricing and a material recommendation.
